answer: Each account may submit a signed claim, but only claims backed by a bond locked in a shared registry can earn fees. A verifier checks that the signer controls the bonded key and that the same bond is not pledged elsewhere; copied credentials cannot forge extra claims because the registry records one owner per bond. After disputes, proven fraud burns the bond. The delta between expected rewards and this forfeiture makes creating many identities costly, while an inlet for new agents remains open to anyone willing to stake value.
